release: PDKS 0.5.0 Personal Capture Runtime Architecture & Reference Implementation

cross_agent_host_validation.note: Multi-agent local API and scoped token contract are implemented, but no native ChatGPT/Claude/Codex/Cursor host adapter has been tested in this release.

shacl.reason: pySHACL is not installed in the local execution environment; CI workflow installs requirements-dev.txt.

capability_boundaries: OCR, ASR, PDF, video, XLSX and PPTX deep extraction are not implemented.
Microphone, camera, location, desktop and wearable background capture are not implemented.
Remote/TLS API, secure relay, multi-device sync, production encryption and KMS are not implemented.
The Capture Runtime performs JSON Schema, owner, source, evidence and consent checks; it does not execute OWL reasoning or SHACL validation inside the runtime.
